reading.body:
The LexisNexis Springfield facility occupies 62,000 square feet in Springfield, Ohio, with 20,000 square feet of raised floor data storage space. The operator states 6 megawatts of power capacity, derived from three synchronized 2 megawatt diesel generators. At typical AI training density of 40 kilowatts per rack, this would support roughly 150 racks, though the actual IT load and its composition are not published.

This facility ranks fifth among the eight Ohio data centers with published power specifications, and accounts for roughly 10 percent of the state's total published capacity of 60.4 megawatts. The state has 76 mapped data center facilities overall, the vast majority of which publish no power figure.

The facility's power comes from diesel generation rather than grid connection, which means it operates independently of Ohio's electricity supply constraints. The source material does not specify certifications, security clearances, accelerator inventory, or current tenant use.
